title: Diploma In Information Technology (Level 3)
description: Build practical skills in computer systems, networks, coding, and cyber security to thrive in today's digital landscape.
longDescription: This Level 3 Diploma in Information Management provides learners with a strong foundation in managing digital systems and technologies. It covers essential areas such as computer systems, coding and web development, networks, and mobile communications. Learners will also explore cyber security practices and the use of social media for business engagement. The course supports career readiness by blending technical know-how with real-world applications. Participants gain relevant skills to support roles in IT support, digital marketing, and network management. Time Table The programme runs from 26 October 2026 to 26 July 2027, covering six academic learning and assessment periods. Teaching includes guided lectures, practical activities, case studies, group discussions, independent study and assignment preparation. A Winter Vacation is scheduled from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027, followed by a Spring Vacation from 29 March to 16 April 2027. The final period focuses on assignment completion, assessment, quality assurance, academic review and confirmation of programme completion, with results processed in August 2027.

outcomes: Demonstrate understanding of the components and functions of modern computer systems used in business and personal environments.
Apply basic programming techniques to design, develop, and test simple applications and websites.
Develop and publish interactive web pages using standard web development languages such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Explain how computer networks operate, including key concepts such as protocols, IP addressing, and network topologies.
Evaluate the role of mobile communication technologies and their impact on personal productivity and business operations.
Identify potential cyber security threats and apply fundamental security practices to protect data and systems.
Understand the principles of secure data management and apply techniques for safeguarding information.
Analyze how businesses use social media platforms to engage customers, build brands, and drive sales.
Create a basic digital marketing strategy using appropriate social media tools and analytics.
Use information management tools and systems to collect, store, retrieve, and present data effectively for business decision-making.
